text:
Screenshot Studio

 

 

A free, open-source editor for screenshots, mockups, and social graphics. No signup or watermarks.

Open the editor · Image tools · Code to image · App Store screenshots

 What you can make

- Screenshot designs: backgrounds, browser and device frames, shadows, and 3D perspective.
- Text-only graphics: start without an image; choose Inter, Geist, or other fonts, then drag or center your text.
- Layered compositions: text, images, annotations, and blur regions.
- Store and social assets: ready-made layouts and exact export sizes, including Chrome Web Store screenshots.
- Images and motion: PNG, JPEG, WebP, batch ZIP, MP4, WebM, and GIF exports.
- Quick edits: resize to ready-made sizes like passport photos, crop by hand, convert, compress, and remove image backgrounds.

 Run locally

Requires Node.js 20.9+ and npm.

 

Open localhost:3000. The browser editor needs no running database; DATABASE URL is required by Prisma during startup and builds. Server-side screenshot caching requires PostgreSQL and R2 credentials; see the cache configuration.

 Contribute

Read CONTRIBUTING.md for the workflow and checks. Built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Zustand.

Created by Kartik Labhshetwar and maintained together with Aniket Rawat.

install.title: Run locally
install.html:
Requires Node.js 20.9+ and npm.

git clone https://github.com/opennookorg/screenshot-studio.git
cd screenshot-studio
npm ci
printf 'DATABASE_URL="postgresql://localhost:5432/screenshot_studio"\n' > .env
npm run dev

Open localhost:3000. The browser editor needs no running database; DATABASE_URL is required by Prisma during startup and builds. Server-side screenshot caching requires PostgreSQL and R2 credentials; see the cache configuration.
